title: GrowthBook SDK picker (v2)
description: A lavender band split by hairline rails: heading, paragraph and violet + outline buttons on the left; on the right a white panel with a gradient edge holding a framework select, a round icon with the SDK's name, a dark code block with lime strings and a copy button, and a dotted mono docs link. Phones stack the panel under the text.
notes: needs JavaScript for the select and copy button (hydrate: visible)
the code block always uses the theme's dark colours (dark class)
